description: Defines the CellRange class which manages a range of cell addresses within a worksheet in PhpSpreadsheet library, including validation and string representation.

classes.name: CellRange
classes.description: Represents a range of cells, defined by starting and ending CellAddress objects, with validation for worksheet compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a CellRange object with start and end CellAddresses, validating their order and worksheet compatibility.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Validates and orders the from and to CellAddresses to ensure top-left and bottom-right positions.

methods.name: validateWorksheets
methods.description: Checks if the two worksheets belong to the same spreadsheet and are compatible for a range.

methods.name: cellAddressWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapped CellAddress with navigation methods for moving between cells.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting CellAddress of the range.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending CellAddress of the range.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the cell range in spreadsheet notation.
